posts.name: Aditya Gupta
posts.cooked:
Dear SC Team,

I hope you’re doing well. Many students faced severe difficulties submitting BPT 1 due to heavy traffic on the IITM servers. The platform was lagging, freezing, and even failing to register submissions, making it extremely challenging to complete the process on time.

Given these unforeseen technical issues, I kindly request an extension of the BPT 1 deadline so that all students get a fair chance to submit their answers properly.

Looking forward to your response. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Best regards,
Aditya Gupta
